title: Playgo: Prompt a game into existence, remix anyone else's. Looking for beta testers
author: Techronian
selftext:
Hey! I run the community for **Playgo**. It’s a TikTok-style mobile app (iOS + Android) where you type a prompt, or toss in a meme or a song, and get a playable game in a few minutes. Everything goes into a swipeable feed, and anyone can remix anyone’s game.

We’re in beta and would love feedback from people who are into AI game gen. What impresses you, where it breaks, what makes remixing fun or annoying.

We do a live group playtest once a week (we pick the day based on when most people can make it), and someone who shows up wins a $20 Amazon gift card each week.

Come hang: [https://discord.com/invite/wyb4qDgZeX](https://discord.com/invite/wyb4qDgZeX)
